name: controller-reads-registry-credentials
reason: The controller resolves OCI registry credentials from Secrets referenced in Repository and Resource custom resources, so its ClusterRole needs get/list/watch on Secrets. It does not grant create, update, or delete.

name: controller-needs-api-access
reason: The controller authenticates to the Kubernetes API with its service account token, so the token is mounted (C-0034) and the service account has RBAC bindings (C-0053 reports every bound service account). Mounting the token explicitly with automount disabled only moves the finding to Trivy KSV-0036.
